name: WayriCAD Via Stitching
description: Preview net-aware copper-zone via stitching with geometric clearance exclusions.
description_full: Local, reviewable routing with configurable geometry, pad/net scope, clearance checks, zoomable preview, shared headless planners, and recoverable named commit groups. Preview does not modify PCB copper. JSON/SVG command-line planning and verified application write a new board copy.
